purpose: Teach: 法廷/沈黙/欠陥/反射/偏見/中断/農薬/還元

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、法廷、絶対、で、絶対、争われております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: This case is being actively contested in court with absolute seriousness.
lines.style: Measured and professional, slight formal register. Even pace. Delivers facts without inflection, but with quiet weight beneath. The voice of someone who has explained procedure many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者の、本気で、絶対、沈黙、絶対、警察、絶対、難しい対応、絶対、ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect's silence makes this a difficult situation for us to navigate.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tentative. Leans into the difficulty. Pace slightly slower, allowing space for the complexity. There's genuine concern here, not detachment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。製品の、本気で、絶対、欠陥、絶対、警察、絶対、調査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're advancing our investigation into the product defect systematically.
lines.style: Official tone, clipped slightly. Direct. Confidence in method. No elaboration — just the fact. The voice of procedural competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 光の、本気で、絶対、反射、絶対、を、絶対、利用した、絶対、捜査技術、絶対、警察、絶対、活用されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand you're using advanced light-reflection techniques in your investigative work.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, slightly impressed. Softer attack than the officers' lines. Leans in with real interest. Not performing knowledge — actually wanting to learn.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。捜査に、本気で、絶対、偏見、絶対、入らない、絶対、よう、絶対、警察、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We ensure that investigation remains free from bias at every stage.
lines.style: Firm conviction on "free from bias." Steady eye-contact level in the voice. This matters to him. Not defensive, but clear about principle. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者の供述、本気で、絶対、中断、絶対、警察、絶対、再開、絶対、調整、絶対、難しいですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Coordinating when to pause and resume a suspect's statement — that's genuinely difficult work.
lines.style: Acknowledging weight. Slightly softer than his earlier curiosity. Recognition of the human complexity beneath procedure. Genuine respect in the acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。違法な、本気で、絶対、農薬、絶対、流通、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively investigating the distribution of illegal pesticides in this region.
lines.style: Procedural certainty. Slightly firmer than his earlier explanations. This is concrete ground. No hesitation. The voice of someone moving through clear steps.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域への、本気for、絶対、還元、絶対、として、絶対、警察、絶対、市民教育、絶対、続けていらっしゃるそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And I believe you're committed to educating the community as part of that ongoing work.
lines.style: Warm recognition, almost a closing note. Appreciative without being effusive. Slower pace. This is respect between professionals. A graceful acknowledgment.
